title: Talk it through 2.4
role: Supervisor discussing how a personal problem is affecting someone's work
can_do: I can talk about how personal problems affect professional life.
I can raise a sensitive issue and respond with empathy.

nodes.partner_line: I wanted to check in. You have seemed distracted lately.
nodes.translation: Quería saber cómo estás. Últimamente te has visto distraído.

options.text: Thank you for asking. I have been dealing with a family problem.
I know. It has been a difficult month for me.
Sorry, I have had a lot on my mind.

nodes.partner_line: I am sorry to hear that. Is it affecting your work?
nodes.translation: Lamento oír eso. ¿Está afectando tu trabajo?
nodes.model_reply: Yes, it has affected my concentration.

nodes.partner_line: Which tasks are the hardest for you right now?
nodes.translation: ¿Qué tareas son las más difíciles para ti ahora?

nodes.partner_line: What kind of support would help you most?
nodes.translation: ¿Qué tipo de apoyo te ayudaría más?

options.text: A more flexible schedule for a few weeks.
Some days of leave to sort things out.
Fewer tasks until things settle down.

nodes.partner_line: That is reasonable. We can arrange it, if you keep me informed.
nodes.translation: Es razonable. Podemos organizarlo si me mantienes informado.

options.text: I will, thank you. I really appreciate it.
Of course. I will update you every Friday.
That is very kind. I will not take advantage of it.

nodes.partner_line: And remember, this conversation is confidential.
nodes.translation: Y recuerda, esta conversación es confidencial.

options.text: Thank you. That means a lot.
Understood. Thanks again for your support.
